company.name: Counsel Health
company.shortDescription: The modern front door to healthcare. AI meets real doctors for instant, personalized, and safe medical guidance—anytime, anywhere.
company.description:
Counsel Health is an AI-enabled virtual care company that combines medical AI with in-house physicians to deliver immediate, personalized guidance for nearly any medical concern.

Built with enterprise-grade safety standards and AI safety guardrails, Counsel partners with health plans, employers, and ecosystem partners to provide a modern, physician-supervised front door to care that significantly improves member access to care while ensuring clinical quality. By replacing outdated access points like nurse advice lines and legacy telehealth, Counsel helps organizations reduce high-cost claims, increase utilization of existing benefits, and improve engagement, all while delivering care that is reliable, cost-effective, and scalable.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $47,432,275 to $124,304,159, a 2.62x increase.

insights.statement: Counsel Health has a recent strategic-positioning change; 1 recent unique news titles explicitly contain the English terms IPO or listing.
insights.implication: Their timing coincides with increased visibility in the loaded news and Crunchbase momentum signals, but the data does not establish causation.

insights.statement: Recent headline metadata discusses an IPO or listing, while Crunchbase’s model assigns a 27.72% IPO probability.
